dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Ah, sure. I can explain that again, no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: You have to collect the materials needed for the three processes while carrying the Collector on your person.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: The first step is "Source Material Collection." Ore, fruits, flowers, and the like can serve as such base materials.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: The second step is "Elemental Charge," which can only be achieved by staying affected by the elements for a certain duration.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Finally, we have "Core Activation," which can be done by defeating some elemental life forms to achieve the motive force required to start the core up.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: After this, the Material Collector should have finished collecting all we need. Then, it just needs to be placed into the Great Machine to begin production.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: If you have any other questions, feel free to ask me.
